title: Joseph Smith possibly killed by government agents, and the state of Deseret

tellings.quote: Joseph Smith actually may have been assassinated by agents of the government.

plain: Joseph Smith, the founder of the Mormon church, "actually may have been assassinated by agents of the government," according to the national security analyst Matthew Pines. He tells Michels this in connection with the 1840s and Deseret, the name the early Mormons gave to the state they hoped to found in what is now Utah. He offers no named source, and the claim would mean the government saw Smith's movement as a threat worth killing over.
